evidence.title: DesignMD — Generate DESIGN.md Files with AI
DesignMD — Generate DESIGN.md Files with AI

name: DesignMD
summary: Paste a URL and get a DESIGN.md with measured colour roles, type scale, spacing, radii, component styles and breakpoints.
description: Generates a plain-text DESIGN.md from any website, measuring tokens in a real browser against the rendered page rather than screenshotting it. Outputs a single-page or multi-page spec, an HTML preview and a Figma token import; a CLI and an agent skill let coding agents generate one for a reference site before writing UI code.
contains: DESIGN.md from a single page (4 credits) or several pages of one site (8 credits)
HTML preview 8 credits; Figma token import 12 credits
tokens measured in a real browser against the rendered page, not inferred from a screenshot
CLI @crowdlinker/designmdme on npm, packaged also as an agent skill
Discover: free-to-read DESIGN.md files for well-known sites; Compare: two systems side by side
credits: 4 free on first visit plus 20 on sign-in; packs $5/50, $15/175, $30/375
